url.credentials_in_authority.title: Hidden real domain
url.credentials_in_authority.detail: Text before @ can make the address look as if it belongs somewhere else, while the host after @ is the one actually used. Observed value: {username}, {host}.

url.ip_literal_host.title: IP address host
url.ip_literal_host.detail: The link uses an IP address instead of a normal domain name, making ownership harder to judge. Observed value: {host}.

url.non_standard_port.title: Unusual port
url.non_standard_port.detail: The port is not standard for common web links. It may be legitimate, but deserves extra checking. Observed value: {port}.

url.punycode_host.title: Technical domain spelling
url.punycode_host.detail: The domain has a technical IDN form and a display form. Such domains can be legitimate, including Norwegian names, but should be read carefully. Observed value: {punycodeHost}, {unicodeHost}.

url.mixed_script_host.title: Mixed writing systems
url.mixed_script_host.detail: The host mixes writing systems. Similar letters from different scripts can make the domain hard to read correctly. Observed value: {host}, {scripts}.

url.confusable_host.title: Confusable domain
url.confusable_host.detail: The host contains characters that can look like other characters. This can make a domain appear familiar. Observed value: {host}, {skeleton}.

url.bidi_control_characters.title: Hidden text direction
url.bidi_control_characters.detail: The content contains characters that can change text direction on screen. This can hide or reorder parts of the address.

url.control_characters.title: Control characters found
url.control_characters.detail: The content contains invisible control characters. They can confuse display, copying, or interpretation.

url.excessive_subdomains.title: Many subdomains
url.excessive_subdomains.detail: The address has many subdomains before the main domain. This can make the real domain harder to spot. Observed value: {count}.

url.brand_in_subdomain.title: Known name in subdomain
url.brand_in_subdomain.detail: A known name appears before the main domain, but that does not prove the link belongs to that organization. Observed value: {brand}, {registrableDomain}.

url.brand_in_path.title: Known name in path
url.brand_in_path.detail: A known name appears in the path after the domain. That part is freely controlled by the site. Observed value: {brand}.

url.hyphenated_brand_domain.title: Hyphenated known name
url.hyphenated_brand_domain.detail: A known name is combined with a hyphen or extra words in another domain. This is often used for impersonation. Observed value: {brand}, {registrableDomain}.

url.nested_url_in_query.title: Link inside link
url.nested_url_in_query.detail: The address contains another web address as a value. Such patterns are often used for redirects. Observed value: {nestedHost}.

url.open_redirect_parameter.title: Possible redirect
url.open_redirect_parameter.detail: A parameter name suggests the link may send the user onward. The start and end sites may differ. Observed value: {parameter}.

url.encoded_characters_in_host.title: Encoded host
url.encoded_characters_in_host.detail: The host contains percent-encoded characters. That can make the domain less clear.

url.excessive_length.title: Very long address
url.excessive_length.detail: The address is very long. Important information may be hidden far into the text. Observed value: {length}.

url.insecure_scheme.title: No HTTPS
url.insecure_scheme.detail: The link does not use HTTPS. Traffic may be easier to observe or alter in transit.

url.javascript_scheme.title: JavaScript link
url.javascript_scheme.detail: The content is a javascript: address. It can run code and must not be opened automatically.

url.data_scheme.title: Embedded data address
url.data_scheme.detail: The content is inside a data: address. It can display like a web page without a normal domain.

url.file_scheme.title: Local file address
url.file_scheme.detail: The address points to a local file or system path, not an ordinary website.

url.unknown_scheme.title: Unknown link type
url.unknown_scheme.detail: The scheme is not a normal http or https link. It may open an app or start an action. Observed value: {scheme}.

url.shortener.title: Shortened link
url.shortener.detail: The link uses a shortening service. The final destination is not visible until redirect expansion is checked. Observed value: {service}.

url.suspicious_tld.title: Unusual top-level domain
url.suspicious_tld.detail: The top-level domain appears more often in abuse. This is a weak signal and must be considered with other evidence. Observed value: {tld}.

url.known_malicious.title: Known malicious match
url.known_malicious.detail: The address matches local threat data. That is concrete evidence to avoid or block the link. Observed value: {ruleId}.

url.no_registrable_domain.title: No main domain
url.no_registrable_domain.detail: We could not find a registrable main domain. Ownership and public suffix handling are therefore less certain. Observed value: {host}.

payload.not_a_url.title: Not a web address
payload.not_a_url.detail: The QR content does not look like a normal web address. It may still be text or another format.

payload.empty.title: Empty content
payload.empty.detail: The QR code contains no text that can be assessed. Scan again if this was not expected.

payload.binary_content.title: Binary content
payload.binary_content.detail: The content resembles binary data or text that cannot be displayed safely. It is not opened automatically.

payload.wifi_network.title: Wi‑Fi network
payload.wifi_network.detail: The QR code describes a Wi‑Fi network. Check that the network is expected before connecting. Observed value: {ssid}, {security}.

payload.wifi_open_network.title: Open Wi‑Fi
payload.wifi_open_network.detail: The QR code describes an open Wi‑Fi network. Such networks usually do not encrypt traffic to the router. Observed value: {ssid}.

payload.wifi_hidden_network.title: Hidden Wi‑Fi
payload.wifi_hidden_network.detail: The QR code describes a hidden Wi‑Fi network. Hidden does not automatically mean safer. Observed value: {ssid}.

payload.email_address.title: Email address
payload.email_address.detail: The QR code contains an email address. Sending email is a separate action. Observed value: {address}.

payload.phone_number.title: Phone number
payload.phone_number.detail: The QR code contains a phone number. Check the number before calling. Observed value: {number}.

payload.sms_message.title: SMS message
payload.sms_message.detail: The QR code can create an SMS. Read the recipient and content before sending. Observed value: {number}.

payload.premium_rate_number.title: Possible premium number
payload.premium_rate_number.detail: The number may have extra cost or a special rate. Check price and recipient first. Observed value: {number}.

payload.geo_location.title: Geographic location
payload.geo_location.detail: The QR code contains a geographic position. Opening it may show or share a location. Observed value: {latitude}, {longitude}.

payload.contact_card.title: Contact card
payload.contact_card.detail: The QR code contains a contact card. Check the details before saving them. Observed value: {name}.

payload.calendar_event.title: Calendar event
payload.calendar_event.detail: The QR code contains a calendar event. Review time and details before adding it. Observed value: {summary}.

payload.crypto_address.title: Crypto address
payload.crypto_address.detail: The QR code contains a crypto address. Such payments usually cannot be reversed. Observed value: {currency}.

payload.otp_secret.title: One-time-code secret
payload.otp_secret.detail: The QR code contains a one-time-code secret. It can give access to login codes. Observed value: {issuer}.

payload.app_deep_link.title: App link
payload.app_deep_link.detail: The QR code uses an app link. It can open an app or start an action. Observed value: {scheme}.

limitation.offline_no_reputation.title: No online lookup
limitation.offline_no_reputation.detail: The check was done without online reputation lookup. The result relies on local rules and structure.

limitation.redirect_not_expanded.title: Redirect not checked
limitation.redirect_not_expanded.detail: We detected a shortened link, but did not fetch the final address. That requires a separate consent-based lookup. Observed value: {service}.

limitation.rules_stale.title: Rules may be old
limitation.rules_stale.detail: The local rules may be old. New threats may be missing until an update. Observed value: {ageDays}.

limitation.rules_unavailable.title: Rules unavailable
limitation.rules_unavailable.detail: Local threat rules were unavailable. Structural findings may still be shown.

limitation.classifier_unavailable.title: Classifier unavailable
limitation.classifier_unavailable.detail: The local classifier was unavailable. The result relies on rules and observable properties.

limitation.no_public_suffix_match.title: Unknown public suffix
limitation.no_public_suffix_match.detail: We could not find a known public suffix. The main domain may therefore be calculated with less certainty. Observed value: {host}.

limitation.payload_not_understood.title: Unknown QR format
limitation.payload_not_understood.detail: The QR format was not understood. The content is shown as raw text without triggering actions.

verdict.known_malicious.title: Known malicious
verdict.known_malicious.detail: We found a concrete match in threat data or rules. Do not open the link without a specific reason.

verdict.suspicious.title: Suspicious
verdict.suspicious.detail: We found signs often used in scams or misleading links. Read the findings before continuing.

verdict.insufficient_evidence.title: Insufficient evidence
verdict.insufficient_evidence.detail: We cannot say enough about the content or final destination. That does not mean it is safe.

verdict.no_known_threat_found.title: No known threat found
verdict.no_known_threat_found.detail: We found no known threats in this check. This is not a guarantee that the content is safe.

redirect.cross_domain.title: Ends on a different domain
redirect.cross_domain.detail: The link starts on {fromDomain} but ends on {toDomain}. A different owner controls the page you would actually reach.

redirect.multiple_hops.title: Passes through several addresses
redirect.multiple_hops.detail: The link redirects {hopCount} times before arriving. Extra steps make the destination harder to predict.

redirect.excessive_hops.title: Unusually long redirect chain
redirect.excessive_hops.detail: The link redirects {hopCount} times. Chains this long are uncommon for ordinary links and are often used to obscure where you end up.

redirect.downgrade_to_http.title: Falls back to an unencrypted connection
redirect.downgrade_to_http.detail: The chain moves from an encrypted connection to an unencrypted one at {host}. Anything sent there can be read or altered on the way.

redirect.chained_shorteners.title: Several shorteners in a row
redirect.chained_shorteners.detail: The link passes through {count} shortening services. Stacking shorteners hides the destination and is rare in legitimate links.

redirect.loop.title: Redirects in a circle
redirect.loop.detail: The chain returns to an address it had already visited at {host}, so it never settles on a destination.

redirect.meta_refresh.title: Redirects using page content
redirect.meta_refresh.detail: The page at {host} redirects using its own content instead of a normal server redirect. This is sometimes used to avoid automated checks.

limitation.redirect_resolution_failed.title: Could not follow the link
limitation.redirect_resolution_failed.detail: The final address could not be determined: {reason}. This assessment covers only the scanned link.

limitation.redirect_partial.title: Only partly followed
limitation.redirect_partial.detail: Following stopped after {hopCount} steps, so the final address is unknown. This assessment covers only what was reached.

online.disclosure.title: Before you expand
online.disclosure.detail: If you continue, this link's address is sent to our resolver service. Our server visits the link and follows its redirects. Your device never contacts the link.

online.resolving.title: Contacting our resolver...
online.resolving.detail: Your device is not contacting the link.

online.outcome_resolved.title: Followed to the final destination
online.outcome_resolved.detail: We followed the redirects for you. This does not mean the destination is safe - read the findings below.

online.outcome_max_hops.title: Stopped: too many redirects
online.outcome_max_hops.detail: This link was judged untrusted because it kept redirecting past the safe limit of 5 hops.

online.outcome_incomplete.title: Could not finish expanding this link
online.outcome_incomplete.detail: Your device still did not contact the link. See what could not be determined below.

online.error.title: The link could not be expanded
online.error.detail: Something went wrong contacting our resolver. Your device did not contact the link. You can try again.
